    Research and policy design

    KIBOR reform

    KIBOR-to-WALR pass-through regressions, with Granger causality and Johansen cointegration tests on SME fixed investment and sectoral NPLs. Argues for a transaction-anchored benchmark.

    Work in progress

    The productivity trap

    Tests whether high microfinance intermediation costs undermine borrower mobility, using loan-level data on repeat borrowers, pricing and facility size.

    Ongoing

    Second-life EV batteries

    Techno-economic feasibility and circular value creation for a second-life battery market in Pakistan, centred on 2W and 3W vehicles. Targeting Energy for Sustainable Development.
